chunks: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear and take heed?

key_terms.أَلَا: Will they not/Is it not that

ai.seo_question: Who are the people of Pharaoh in the Quran and what lesson does their story teach about taqwa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara underscores the collective arrogance of Pharaoh's court, serving as a paradigmatic warning against the rejection of divine messengers despite clear signs. It invites believers to cultivate taqwa by reflecting on the historical consequences of their disobedience, reinforcing the continuity of prophetic messages across eras.
